lines.en: : ...and from that point on, I decided it would be in the best interest of the universe if I just never encountered a live salmon again.
: Which is fine! I just need to be extra careful if I ever visit the Pacific Northwest in Q4 of any given year. We have enough clown-based fatalities as-is.
: Thank God you explained the foundation of this story in the beginning. I can only imagine how confusing it would be for someone to walk in at the tail end of it.
: I particularly enjoyed the connections drawn between 70’s shag carpeting and aquatic mating routines. I feel as if I have learned a lot today.
: It’s crazy to think about how carpets like that used to be a thing at all. Style today is all about being sleek and clean. I’d hate having to vacuum something like that so often.
: Speaking of style, Ami — what’s the plan with your hair?
: Are you gonna grow it back out again and rejoin me in the OG haircut club? Otoha brought back the top-knot, so I think she’s planning on joining as well.
: It was either that or the straight girls club Miku is starting. Which I’m pretty sure neither one of us is  allowed to join based on the fact that we have made out like a million times.
: Oh! Ami and I joined that and we’ve kissed before, so I don’t think the screening process is very thorough.
: If it was just kissing, maybe. But I’m not sure I’d be able to live with myself if I joined a straight girls club after all of the other stuff you did to me.
: Please explain these things now. My sexual curiosity is at an all-time high and I require assistance in determining whether or not I am attracted to female traits apart from Ami’s legs.
: I’m not sure if I’m allowed. Rin’s new guard dog might show up and try to gut me if I talk about that again.
: Chika’s not a guard dog, Otoha! She’s just...a friend! A...really close friend. Who is...certainly more protective than normal lately...but still just a friend!
: Mhm, right. And I was a good girlfriend.
: You were! Best I’ve ever had at least. I’d give you a solid 7/10. Guitar skills translate well to-
: Sorry to interrupt...whatever this is, but I’m still not really sure about what to do. And I was actually wondering what you guys would suggest.
: Ayane? Tsuneyo? Short hair Ami or long hair Ami? Which one’s better?
: I like long hair Ami. Short hair Ami is good too, but twintails are lacking proper representation now and Io’s aren’t really as impressive as yours were.
: Personally, I am too invested in why characters are always pictured holding food in video games but never actually eating it.
: Hm? Oh, this? I’ll eat it now!
: Hah...it’s no use. Perhaps it is just impossible to properly depict based on asset restrictions.
: Cast my vote for short hair. It’s nice having some competition in the princely department.
: Plus, from what I hear, some of the girls in other classes have already started crushing on you, Ami.
: Girls in other classes don’t exist to me and your new hair makes me want to touch you, so I vote for long hair Ami again so I don’t have to feel conflicted about that anymore.
: What about you, Futaba? Any preference? Or should I maybe try and split the difference and go for, like...medium length or something?
: Futaba’s locked in right now. Don’t think you’ll be getting an answer from her.
: You want breakfast or anything, Futaba? I can go grab you something from the shack. Coffee, maybe?
: No thank you.
: Kay. Just make sure you eat something later, alright? You skipped dinner last night too. We need all the energy we can get for D&D later.
: Okay.
: What are you writing, Futaba? Another fantasy thing?
: Essay.
: Ew, homework? Now? But this is vacation.
: Not homework. Looks like an essay on-
: Western civilization? Why? Are you applying to colleges already?
: Please...shut up.
: See — the reason Otoha is so dumbfounded right now is because she’s secretly racist and hates western civilization. It was a real problem for our relationship.
: It came up literally once!
: After you struck me! Coincidence? I think not...
: PLEASE. SHUT UP.
: Oh, Sensei. You’re up early. Good morning.
: I’m not awake because I want to be. Io snuck into my room again and accidentally knocked something over.
: Is that a...thing she does often?
: It’s like that thing people say about not feeding stray animals who wander into your yard. If you do, they’ll keep coming back.
: What’s going on over there? Was that Futaba I just heard raising her voice?
: Yeah. She was up all night writing. Came here to try and get some peace once the other girls started waking up but, lo and behold, peace is no more.
: Knowing that makes it sound like you were up all night as well.

: I was! Which means I am also very tired. But fortunately, I should be able to ride a caffeine wave for the rest of the day. And I got a lot done. So I’d say it was an excellent use of my infinite time.
: A lot done in regard to...what, exactly?
: Reset stuff. I think I’ve found a way to make the Rooftop Apocalypse Squad’s activities a lot more exciting and fun so we’re not just standing around waiting for something to happen all the time.
: I’m gonna talk to Maya and Yumi about it later. Tsuneyo and Nodoka too, but both of them have been acting kind of...off.
: Really? Tsuneyo looks fine to me. Perhaps...too fine. Is Imani really letting her wear that?
: Miss Imai’s been drooling over her just as much as you have. Just she has the tact to not say anything out loud.
: She has more underboob than you have regular boob.
: Okay. Well, that was just unnecessary.
: So, Otoha! How’s my little Sana getting along in the light music club? She’s not causing you guys any problems, is she?
: Honestly? She’s not bad at all. She has some issues with the bass pedal, but her timing is solid and Rika’s been working pretty closely with her after school most days.
: We’re still just in the covers phase right now since we haven’t been able to decide on a direction for the band. But I think we might actually be able to start working on an original soon.
: Thankfully, I’ve got like a million banked already. Just have to find the right one, you know? Like there’s this one that goes-
: Hey. You good?
: No.
: Wanna go back to the room? Maybe somewhere quieter? I know you’re trying to work.
: Yeah. I’d be much happier failing where no one can watch me. Great fucking idea, Rin. Why didn’t I think of that?
: Huh? I just-
: Just shut the fuck up and stop checking on me every five minutes! No wonder Otoha hit you when you did the same fucking thing to her!
: Woah! Where did that come from? That’s not like you, Futaba.
: Oh, what? So they can joke about it? But when I do it, it’s a fucking problem?! Fuck you too, Ayane! Why don’t you mind your own fucking business?!
: ...What?
: Uhh...
: You didn’t...hear what started this, did you? Because I feel like I stopped paying attention for literally five seconds and now this is happening.
: No...I have no clue.
: I...feel like we should probably do something, though.
: Not me. I’m running on zero hours of sleep and am not particularly well-loved among peers. This has “you” written all over it.
: Just give me some fucking space! It’s infuriating enough that I have to look at all of you all weekend! But being pitied as well?! Just let me fucking work!
: I came over here to get away from you! Remember?! I swear, it’s like all of you exist just to fucking distract me and make my life harder! Just go the fuck away!
: I was just trying to-
: Oh, waaaaaah! I was just trying to help! Oh, woe is me! I have everything a girl could ever need and don’t understand what it’s like to actually suffer!
: Just fucking shut up already! Oh, and stop reminding me to eat as well! Because Sana skipped dinner too and I don’t see you fucking micro-managing her!
: Futaba...I know what’s it’s like to-
: You don’t know shit!
: You’re a fucking prodigy who can write anything she wants whenever the fuck she wants — with loving parents and a home to return to!
: You think you understand what I’m going through just because you also get interrupted sometimes?! Get lost! Go back to your side of the city and stop acting like you belong here!
: Otoha, she doesn’t mean that. Sensei! Can you come here, please?!
: Oh, woooow! Ayane’s calling over Sensei again! What a crazy twist! I haven’t seen her try to get his attention since, what...yesterday? It’s a new fucking record!
: Perhaps I am lacking context here, but I do not understand the cause for such fury from someone who is so typically mind-mannered.
: Yeah, well you don’t fucking understand anything because you somehow have even less personality than me!
: Like, if it wasn’t for riding fucking Molly’s coattails all day, who would you even be? What would you like? Noodles? Awesome. Good for you! How FUCKING interesting!
: I am confused. It sounds as if I am supposed to be insulted by this. But I merely just feel seen.
: BECAUSE YOU’RE A FUCKING MORON! YOU’RE ALL FUCKING MORONS! EVERY ONE OF YOU! AND I CAN’T FUCKING STAND IT ANYMORE! THIS PLACE ISN’T REAL! NONE OF YOU ARE REAL!
: Futaba! Where are you going?!
: I was just about to ask the same thing. Stop.
: Get the fuck out of my way! If you’re looking for someone to suck you off, there’s a whole table full of girls twenty feet away practically begging to! Talk to them instead!
: I don’t want to talk to them. I want to talk to you. I need to know what’s going on.
: Why?! So you can pretend to fucking give a shit again?! Because every time you’ve “helped” me with anything, it was always just to get something!
: And you’ve sure fucking gotten it, Sensei! So many times that I need to use three fingers just to get myself off now! I’m in high school! Do you know how that makes me feel?!
: Futaba! Stop! You’re just making things worse!
: Do you know how fucking shameful it’s going to feel when you ultimately leave me and I have to explain to the next guy I’m with that his dick is too small to make me feel anything?!
: And don’t hit me with some fucking bullshit line like, “Oh, Futaba! I won’t leave you,” either! Because despite having fucked me a thousand times, you still won’t even say you love me!
: What do I have to do to become more than a convenient fucking cock-sleeve to satisfy the pathetic, adolescent desires you should have grown out of a fucking decade ago?!
: Because I can’t do that! And I can’t write! I’m not good at sports! I’m not particularly smart! So what the fuck do I have to offer?! What makes me special?!
: No fucking wonder nobody’s acknowledging any of my contest submissions! They’re probably flagged as fucking spam the moment I send them!
: It’s just hopeless to try! So why even bother?!
: Why not just throw myself into the fucking ocean and never come out?! Because I suck at swimming too! At least I’d make a good meal for a fucking shark!
: Futaba, please. You’re scaring me.
: Then that’s just more proof that something is wrong here.
: Because if you’re scared of me...and not scared of him, that’s just bad writing.
: Think of the readers, Rin. Think of how it looks to have me be the bad guy while the lecherous schoolgirl-fucking “hero” swoops in to save the day. The message is lost.
: We are all lost. And it is your fault. You did this.
: You broke the world.
: And now you’re gonna try and pick up the pieces? Don’t make me laugh.
: I hope you fucking choke on the next tongue unfortunate enough to slither into your mouth.
: Jesus fucking Christ, Futaba! What the hell has gotten into you?!
: Woah...
: That was-
: That was nothing. Forget literally all of that. Something’s clearly wrong and I need to go chase after her to find out what.
: She gets like this when she...well, she...gets like this sometimes. But I could have sworn that-
: I don’t think this is...a regular sort of problem, Rin. I can’t imagine it’s something you’ve dealt with before.
: Yeah, well I don’t exactly have the luxury to think about that right now. I’ll talk to you later, Sensei.
: And...don’t take any of that too personally, please. She doesn’t actually feel that way.
: Right...
But while she might not, some will. Some do.
And so I shout into the void I so routinely dump the rest of my thoughts into, seeking an answer as to why they’ve wrapped their tendrils around her of all people.
But I shout that without realizing she is far from the first — and that countless others may have already been pulled into the abyss.
If you spend long enough in there, you won’t realize how wrong everything is.
Maybe I did break the world if that’s the case.
The only questions then becomes...
When?
Futaba and Rin have exited the update!
